ValidationRule.description: This rule ensures that if the Source of Funds is "Other" and the Region Flag is "Jordan", then both Other Sources of Fund and Expected Amount Range for Other Sources of Income must be filled.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Region_Flag__c, "Jordan"), INCLUDES(Source_of_Funds__c, "Other"), OR( ISBLANK(Other_Sources_of_Fund__c), ISPICKVAL(Expected_Amount_Range__c, "") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Other Sources of Fund and Expected Amount Range are required when 'Other' is selected in Source of Funds.
